title: web: app.js (router, top bar, nav), dom.js, newgame view
criteria:
Write the app shell. Vanilla ES modules, no libraries.

== web/js/dom.js ==
`export function h(tag, attrs = {}, ...children)` builds an element: attrs `class` -> className, `style` as object -> Object.assign(el.style), keys starting with 'on' (onclick...) -> addEventListener(lowercased name without 'on'), `dataset` object, boolean attrs (disabled, hidden, checked, selected) set as properties, everything else setAttribute; children may be strings/numbers (appended as TEXT NODES, never HTML), Nodes, arrays (flattened), or null/false/undefined (skipped). NEVER use innerHTML anywhere in the project. Also export `clear(el)` (remove all children).

== VIEW CONTRACT (later tasks follow it) ==
Every view module exports `async function render(el, ctx, params)`; it may return a cleanup function (called before the next route renders). `el` is the #view element (already cleared). `ctx` = { meta (GET /api/meta), state (StateView or null), village (VillageView of the current village or null), villageId (number or null), toast(message, isError=false), refresh() (refetch state + current village, then re-render the current route), navigate(hash) }. Views render from ctx.village / ctx.state and fetch extra data themselves via api.js. Countdown elements are `<span class="countdown" data-countdown="ISO">` created by views; app.js updates every one of them each second with countdown(iso) and, when one reaches 0 (remainingMs == 0), schedules ONE ctx.refresh() 1.5 s later (debounced).

== web/js/app.js ==
- On load: fetch meta (GET /meta) first, then GET /state. If /state fails with ApiError status 404 -> navigate to '#/new'. Otherwise syncClock(state.game_now), choose the current village (first of state.villages, or the one in the route), fetch GET /villages/{id}.
- Hash router: '#/new' -> views/newgame.js; '#/' and '#/v/:id' -> views/village.js; '#/v/:id/center' and '#/center' -> views/center.js; '#/map' -> views/map.js; '#/reports' and '#/reports/:id' -> views/reports.js; '#/ranking' -> views/ranking.js; '#/rally/:vid' -> views/rally.js. Load view modules with dynamic `import('./views/<name>.js')`; if the import fails (file not written yet) show a panel with the Thai text 'หน้านี้ยังไม่พร้อมใช้งาน'. Unknown hash -> '#/'. params passed to render: { id, vid } as numbers or strings from the route, plus `query` (URLSearchParams of the hash query string). Any ApiError thrown while rendering/refreshing is shown with ctx.toast(error.message, true); the route must not crash.
- Top bar: #resources spans (res-wood, res-stone, res-iron, res-food) tick every 1 second: value = resources[k] + rates[k] * (elapsed game hours since the village was fetched, computed with the game clock), clamped to [0, capacity[k]], shown with fmtNum; the food span gets class 'negative' when rates.food < 0. #clock shows fmtTime(gameNow().toISOString()) each second. #pause-btn: label 'หยุด' when running or 'เล่นต่อ' when state.paused; click -> POST /admin/pause or /admin/resume, then update state and clock. #village-select lists state.villages (option text = name) and navigates to '#/v/<id>' on change; hide it when there is only one village.
- Bottom nav: rewrite the .nav-link hrefs to '#/v/<id>', '#/v/<id>/center', '#/map', '#/reports', '#/ranking' once the village id is known, and add class 'active' to the link matching the current hash.
- ws: onChanged(msg) -> if msg.village_id is null or equals the current village id, debounce 300 ms then ctx.refresh().
- ctx.toast shows text in #toast for 4 seconds (remove `hidden`, set class toast-error for errors, hide again after the timeout; a new toast replaces the old one).
- Re-render rule: refresh() refetches state and village (when a village is selected) then re-renders the current route; keep scroll position and don't re-render while the user is typing in an input/select inside #view (skip that refresh round and retry shortly after).

== web/js/views/newgame.js ==
Route '#/new'. Thai form built with h(): player name input (default 'ผู้เล่น', required), tribe choice as radio cards from ctx.meta.tribes (show name_th and description_th; default first), speed <select> from ctx.meta.speeds (labels like 'x1', 'x3', 'x5', 'x10'), bot count number input (0-60, default 30), optional seed number input, submit button 'เริ่มเกม'. Submit -> api.post('/admin/new-world', {player_name, tribe, speed, bot_count, seed}) (seed null when empty); disable the button while waiting; on success toast 'สร้างโลกแล้ว' then `await ctx.refresh()` is NOT enough because there was no state: instead window.location.hash = '#/' and call ctx.refresh(); on ApiError toast the message. Title 'Realm of Villages' heading and a short Thai subtitle.

== web/css/style.css ==
APPEND at the END of the file a new section '/* app shell + newgame */' with styles for the newgame form, tribe cards (`.tribe-card`, `.tribe-card.selected`), form rows (`.form-row`), and anything app.js needs. Do not modify the existing rules above.
notes:
- Keep the files readable; put the clock/ticker logic in small functions.
- Use `textContent`/h() only. All user-visible strings Thai: double-check spelling letter by letter ('แผนที่', 'อันดับ', 'หมู่บ้าน', 'เล่นต่อ' etc.). Do not invent new Thai words; keep to the strings above.
- ctx.refresh must not be called recursively in parallel: keep an 'inflight' flag and queue one follow-up.
- Use `location.hash` for navigation; ctx.navigate(hash) sets location.hash.
- Run the test_cmd (node --check on every js file) and fix syntax errors.
